challenge_focus: Falsify this candidate on four axes. (1) Verifiability: the packet carries narrative claims about red/green ordering, mutation sensitivity, lane counts, gate cleanliness and binder acceptance -- find where a broken candidate would still satisfy every visible artifact. (2) The instrument: entrypoint_form_census.py claims its docstring IS the definition; hunt for any place the documented counting rule does not reproduce the reported figures, and for values its suite would accept while the parser is wrong. (3) The withdrawal: the round refuses to rewrite entrypoint rules on the strength of a per-rule classification -- attack whether that classification is independently checkable and whether "35 of 36 already endorsed" survives scrutiny. (4) The evidence artifact: a re-serialised runner report presented as a baseline -- attack provenance, comparability, and what a later round inherits if the transformation were wrong.
